name: tombi-wasm-build
description: Tombi formatter, linter, and language server for WebAssembly

scripts.build:copy: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/lib dist/lsp && cp -r ../../typescript/@tombi-toml/wasm-lib/dist/* dist/lib/ && cp -r ../../typescript/@tombi-toml/wasm-lsp/dist/* dist/lsp/ && cp src/lsp-worker.js dist/lsp/worker.js && cp -r www/* dist/
scripts.build: pnpm run build:lib && pnpm run build:lsp && pnpm run build:copy
scripts.test: pnpm run test:lib && pnpm run test:lsp
